title: Help with Posting
description: Learn what to do if you encounter an error message when trying to post or if your post isn't sending. We'll help you troubleshoot and resolve common posting issues.

runs: I'm seeing an error message after posting a post
If you see a "Whoops, you already said that" error message when you post a post, you've posted the exact same text in another post recently, and should try writing something new in your next post.
You should only see this error if you post
the same text as a recent post.
Try posting a different post. If you never post the exact same text in posts you'll never get this error.

Trouble sending posts can often be attributed to a need to upgrade your browser or app. If you’re having trouble posting via the web, make sure you’re using the latest version of your browser.
